title: Add output-anchor variant for shared-product blocks
body:
## Result

This package gives an exact local construction where a required clean output is also the source of a shared bilinear product. For

- `F0 = x0*y0`, with target `A0` clean at entry;
- `Fi = x0*y0 + xi*yi` for `1 <= i < q`, with arbitrary dirty targets `Ai`;

the schedule uses `q` rank-one child calls and `q-1` affine ADD fanouts. Direct separate evaluation uses `2q-1` rank-one calls. A same-output scratch-helper adaptation uses `q+1` calls, `q` ADDs, and one reusable clean helper. The output anchor removes one child call and one ADD per block and eliminates that helper slot. The bilinear tensor rank is exactly `q`.

This is a complementary output-state contract to #1872, which shares one product across all-dirty mixed outputs and cleans a separate helper. The extra improvement over that scratch-helper mechanism is one call per block; the package and certificate state this narrowly.

## Conditional profile screen

For eight hypothetical 112-port blocks, the selected profile would change conditionally from `{1:2412,2:418,3:432,4:142,5:82,8:8}` to `{1:1524,2:418,3:432,4:142,5:82,8:8}`. The pinned exact ceiling brackets are baseline `[1690054109/1000000000000, 169005411/100000000000]` and candidate `[2026751029/1000000000000, 202675103/100000000000]`. This is a 19.9223% relaxation-ceiling increase versus the selected fixed profile, chiefly from the common-product sharing mechanism already studied in #1872.

Against the same-interface scratch-helper adaptation, the candidate ceiling improves by only about 0.1795%; across eight blocks the incremental gain is eight rank-one calls and eight ADDs, while removing one reusable clean helper slot. The profile requires eight clean output anchors and matching common operand pairs in the selected provider. Neither condition has been established, so no provider admission, selected-frontier change, or new `kappa` is claimed.

## Verification

- `python3 -B research/complex-output-anchor-shared-product-seedcc5aed/verify.py` — PASS: symbolic schedules for `q=2..112`, 18,720 exhaustive Boolean input/dirty-target states for `q=2..5`, rank lower-bound schema, dirty-anchor and missing-fanout controls, and exact profile brackets.
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-output-anchor-shared-product-seedcc5aed --check-only` — package metadata and source pins pass.
- Local direct replay used Python 3.14.7. Python 3.12 is unavailable in this environment, so the registered 3.12 runner was not run locally.

The exact task seed, base, selected-record hash, source pins, limitations, certificate, and open placement questions are recorded in the package.
